title: Raycast showcase
description: A two-tone heading, then a framed app-window slot (full-bleed on phones, a 1204px rounded frame on desktop) with a dock of five square keycap buttons at its bottom: the active one is a bigger silver key with a tooltip above it, and choosing one swaps the window and the caption below the frame.
notes: each item has its own media slot; empty it is a token placeholder
needs JavaScript for the dock (state); static HTML shows the first item
name: raycast-showcase
